newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar futures down sharply.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar futures down sharply.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were trading sharply lower by midsession Thursday after benchmark July failed to rocket higher after piercing its upside target, dealers said.
The contract pierced key resistance at 11.20 cents and climbed to a high of 11.21 cents, where traders had believed buy stops were resting.
Steady producer selling kept the contract from racking up further gains, and commission house selling emerged to knock the contract below 11.00 cents.
At 1122 EDT, July stood down 0.15 cent at 11.00 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.21 to 10.94 cents. The outer months were 0.11 lower to 0.04 cent higher.
Traders pegged support at 10.85 cents in July.
Volume was estimated at 11,742 lots as of 1100 EDT.
